purpose: Actionable external evidence queue. Source provenance lives in references/catalog.yml; this file owns uncertainty, next discriminator, acquisition state, and expected project deliverables.

leads.question: What frame-perfect stunt, boost, timing, and RAM knowledge was encoded in the lost USJO v13 Lua bot?
leads.next_discriminator: Passive recovery only: search the full title and version family, reconstruct the old obellemare Uniracers directory from mirrors/backups, fingerprint renamed copies with published WRAM addresses plus period Snes9x Lua APIs, and compare surviving Uniracers Lua for lineage. Do not contact historical authors, TASers, site owners, forum users, or other people.
deliverables: recovered original Lua or any ancestor/descendant/fragment if publicly available
directory/corpus reconstruction record and code-fingerprint results

leads.acquisition_judgment: Potentially useful only if source, measurements or technical artifacts survive; videos/prose alone should not distract from canonical-ROM evidence.

leads.question: Does a current commercial project explicitly inspired by Uniracers expose any transferable design or technical reconstruction knowledge?
leads.next_discriminator: Index the project and developer relationship only; investigate deeper solely if public technical material discusses Uniracers-derived handling, track geometry, stunt economics, or local multiplayer design.
deliverables: context record; no fidelity claims without primary technical evidence

acquisition_policy.rule: Keep all leads searchable, but do not let low marginal-value artifacts block implementation or reverse engineering.

tiers.P0: active hunt; likely to materially reduce implementation uncertainty
tiers.P1: useful corroboration; pursue opportunistically or with cheap automation
tiers.P2: optional evidence; acquire if easy, never block
tiers.P3: archival tail; preserve lead, no bespoke recovery effort unless a new discriminator raises its value
